merchant.name: Mira
merchant.title: General Store
merchant.greeting: Potions and stones for the road!

healer.name: Sister Lune
healer.title: Healer
healer.greeting: Rest a moment. I will mend your wounds.

keeper.name: Old Bram
keeper.title: Storage
keeper.greeting: Leave your things with me. Nothing gets lost here.

captain.name: Captain Rowan
captain.title: Town Guard
captain.greeting: Slimes keep pouring out of the woods. Lend me your sword?

master.name: Master Hale
master.title: Class Master
master.greeting: Reach level 10 and come to me for your trial. Pass it, and your class grows.

lh_merchant.name: Rook
lh_merchant.title: General Store
lh_merchant.greeting: Lantern oil, potions and steel for the deep woods.

lh_healer.name: Brother Wick
lh_healer.title: Healer
lh_healer.greeting: Rest a while by the lanterns, traveller.

lh_keeper.name: Moss
lh_keeper.title: Storage
lh_keeper.greeting: Your things are safe with me, even this far from Willow Town.

lh_guide.name: Lyra
lh_guide.title: Guide
lh_guide.greeting: The lantern roads reach every town and wood. Where to?

lh_warden.name: Warden Thorne
lh_warden.title: Arena Master
lh_warden.greeting: The Lantern Arena is through the hall's door. Beat three waves and the champion for a prize. Three bouts a day. Bring friends, once the roads to other worlds open.

fg_merchant.name: Sigrid
fg_merchant.title: General Store
fg_merchant.greeting: Warm potions and good stones. The cold takes the rest.

fg_healer.name: Mother Isolde
fg_healer.title: Healer
fg_healer.greeting: Come in from the snow, child.

fg_keeper.name: Old Rune
fg_keeper.title: Storage
fg_keeper.greeting: Ice keeps everything. So do I.

fg_guide.name: Edda
fg_guide.title: Guide
fg_guide.greeting: Frostgate is the end of the road north. Shall I send you back?

fg_warden.name: Warden Bjorn
fg_warden.title: Arena Master
fg_warden.greeting: The Frost Arena waits behind the hall's door. Wolves, wraiths and an Ice Golem to finish. Three bouts a day.

weaponsmith.name: Garrick
weaponsmith.title: Weaponsmith
weaponsmith.greeting: A good blade, a good staff, a good bow. Take your pick.

tailor.name: Nell
tailor.title: Tailor
tailor.greeting: Hats, capes, gloves and boots, all sewn right here!

lh_outfitter.name: Tamsin
lh_outfitter.title: Outfitter
lh_outfitter.greeting: Gear for the deep woods. Nothing here will let you down.

fg_stonecutter.name: Halvard
fg_stonecutter.title: Stonecutter
fg_stonecutter.greeting: Stones cut in the cold hold the strongest charm.
